arguments.sql: SELECT t.id AS transaction_id, t.amount_usd_cents / 100.0 AS amount_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 200000 ORDER BY t.id
arguments.explanation: Lists the id and dollar amount of every transaction above $2,000 made on a prepaid debit card, ordered by transaction id.
assumptions: 'Over $2,000' means amount strictly greater than 200000 cents.
Amounts are shown in dollars, computed as cents divided by 100.0.
Transactions are included whether or not they carry a fraud label or an error.
